body:
## What
Pre-registered (R2, receipts/lane-c-edge.md) replacement for the edge bot's keyword routing:
- `edge/synonym_graph.json` — weighted synonym graph (~120 terms, 5 classes) + intent-position config (negation window, but-pivot x1.5, earliest-first-mention tiebreak, fuzzy-1)
- `edge/nl_route.js` — canonical zero-dep router (phrase-first, whole-word, fuzzy-1, negation suppression, but-pivot promotion); CLI: --eval / --prompt / --score

## Measured (R1: rules committed BEFORE the run)
- `node edge/nl_route.js --eval edge/eval_prompts.json` on the pinned set (sha256 32a35de2...): **50/50 = 1.000 top-1**, zero misroutes
- Baseline 0.560 -> +0.440; pre-registered target >=0.85 met
- All 22 prior failures fixed: 14 synonym/paraphrase, 1 misspelling (fuzzy-1), 5 adversarial (intent-position: tiebreak / negation window / but-pivot)
- Receipt: `tools/edge_graph_receipt.json` (v2; v1 keyword-baseline receipt untouched)

## Honest limits
- 50-prompt dev set; not a guarantee of open-vocabulary NL
- TS port into `edge/worker.ts` + automated parity runner: next small item (host exec preflight blocked new script invocations this pulse; parity pinned by inspection, CI to confirm)
- Stacked on `round-5-lane-abcd` (eval set lives there)
title: edge NL: weighted synonym-graph router — 1.000 top-1 on pinned 50-prompt eval (baseline 0.560)
